name: @cver/coral-dock
description: REEF with Dock — corner items (a bubble that opens a panel, or a bubble that is a link) in the shared corner dock. Client (dock.js) is BUILT from dock-client.mjs + dock-core.mjs + shared/dock.mjs + shared/dynamic-coral-css.mjs. Version covers the UNIT: client JS + the data-* attribute API + the dc-dock element/contract and the --dc-dock-* custom properties.
